_comment: Matched ALP hadronic events are supported from 1.910 to 5 GeV with unit event weights. The nominal charm width is unchanged. Its open-charm fraction follows the retained on-shell D-Dstar p^3 threshold prescription, normalized at 4 GeV; the complement produces light hadrons from an ALP-filtered gluon source. This threshold assignment is a modelling assumption, not a calculated charm-to-gluon conversion. Two-pseudoscalar D-Dbar primary states are forbidden. The eta/eta-prime dipion charge correction remains active through 5 GeV, including the additional light response. Below 1.910 GeV the native exclusive path is retained; above 5 GeV matched generation is rejected. Explicit deployment overrides can select historical inputs. Raw Pythia and weighted generation remain explicit choices.
